newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's forint steady vs basket, eases vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's forint steady vs basket, eases vs dollar.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed steady against the central bank basket on Friday but eased slightly versus the dollar in light trading, tracking the dollar/mark cross, dealers said.
The forint remained at the National Bank of Hungary's (NBH) resistance level, or bid, all day and finished at 185.10/15 against the dollar, compared with 184.85/90 at opening.

The forint, which usually trades close to the NBH bid but was up to 50 pips below the resistance level in the past few weeks due to the Czech crown's troubles, returned to the NBH bid on Wednesday and was likely to remain there, traders added.
